あらすじ

Niiza Shou (name changeable) found himself reincarnated in another world, only to be caught in the middle of a clash between two armies.

Thanks to a strange power he awakened during his reincarnation and a series of coincidences, he somehow managed to quell the conflict—and ended up taking control of both forces.

item.title: Shingun Goblin Gundan ~Jinrui-sou Naedoko-ka Sakusen~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CHAOS-R, FREAK STRIKE
  • 発売日: 2022-01-28
  • スコア: 5.6899999999999995/10 (51 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 進軍ゴブリン軍団 〜人類総苗床化作戦〜
  • 英語名: Shingun Goblin Gundan Jinrui-sou Naedoko-ka Sakusen

别名

  • Shingun Goblin Gundan Jinrui-sou Naedoko-ka Sakusen

あらすじ

An eroge with light turn-based gameplay about an army of goblins and their quest to rule the world!

An ordinary man is hit by a truck, and as often happens in these situations, awakens in a fantasy world. One catch; he’s a goblin now! Two rival clans, each run by a pair of beautiful women, rule the continent; naturally, he decides to team up with his kinky goblin fetishest friend to take over the country with an army of goblin children! But where do those goblin children come from? Well, the title says it all; interspecies breeding! The more of the leaders that are captured and impregnated, the more soldiers they produce for the grand goblin conquest!

item.title: Futanari Haha to Goumon Musume
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: CHAOS-R, FREAK STRIKE
  • 発売日: 2021-07-30
  • スコア: 6.12/10 (113 人評価)
  • 日本語名: フタナリ母と拷問娘
  • 英語名: Futanari Haha to Goumon Musume

别名

  • Futanari Mother And Her Torturous Daughter

あらすじ

At first glance the Amashiro family seems like any other ordinary, happy family.

However, the mother, Miki, is a masochist, the father is a mad scientist, and the daughter, Misaki, never shows any sign of emotions. On top of that, a clone of Miki lives together with them, all of which makes the family more than a bit peculiar.
